segments.name: Drone and Robotic Solutions
segments.description: Provides American-made small unmanned aircraft systems and uncrewed surface vessels for defense, national security, and commercial customers.
segments.evidence: We are a U.S.-based provider of advanced all-domain drone and robotic solutions for defense, national security, and commercial applications.

revenueModel.text: Customers, including the U.S. government, issue purchase orders at their own discretion to purchase the company's drone and robotic products.
revenueModel.evidence: Our customers issue purchase orders solely at their own discretion.

changes.text: In 2025, the company launched a new division, Blue Ops, Inc., focused on uncrewed surface vessel weapons systems.
changes.evidence: In August 2025, we announced the launch of our newest division, Blue Ops, Inc., focused on developing a family of battle-tested USV weapons systems that meet the rapidly evolving demands of the modern battlefield.
